  "function": "() => {
  const text = document.body.innerText;
  const snapshotMatch = text.match(/拍摄于[^\n]+/);

  const salesMatch = text.match(/已订购商品的销售额\n(US\$[\d\.]+)/);
  const orderItemsMatch = text.match(/订单商品总数\n(\d+)/);
  
  // Also check comparison table for "今天到目前为止"
  const todayRow = text.match(/今天到目前为止\n到目前为止\n(\d+)[^\n]*\n(US\$[\d\.]+)/);
  
  return {
    snapshotTime: snapshotMatch ? snapshotMatch[0] : 'unknown',
    units: unitsMatch ? unitsMatch[1] : (todayRow ? todayRow[1] : 'unknown'),
    sales: salesMatch ? salesMatch[1] : (todayRow ? todayRow[2] : 'unknown'),
    orderItems: orderItemsMatch ? orderItemsMatch[1] : 'unknown',
    fullSnippet: text.slice(0, 1500)
  };
}",
  "pageId": 7
}
